answer: The ripple index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the horizon queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1324 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ridge. Each copy needs 9 hours of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
